title: Transcendence basis of a field extension
statement: Let $K/k$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension]. For a family $(x_i)_{i\in I}$ of elements of $K$ write $k(x_i;i\in I)$ for the subfield of $K$ generated by $k$ and the $x_i$: the intersection of all subfields of $K$ containing $k$ and every $x_i$ (it is a subfield containing $k$ and all $x_i$, contained in every such subfield). A *transcendence basis* of $K/k$ is a family $(x_i)_{i\in I}$ of elements of $K$ that is algebraically independent over $k$ [def-kun-transcendence-degree] (the $k$-algebra map $k[X_i;i\in I]\to K$, $X_i\mapsto x_i$, is injective) and such that the extension $K/k(x_i;i\in I)$ is algebraic [def-weil-algebraic-element]: every element of $K$ is a root of a nonzero polynomial with coefficients in $k(x_i;i\in I)$.
